runtimeTrace.evidenceDetail: GeneratedExercise can carry step-up alternation metadata.
Generated sessions can receive one pinned step-up plan when gated.
Selector routes only gated internal V2.1-capable step-up items.
Screen can pass internal capabilities and player owns one runtime.
Adapter derives observed lead, top phase, return, floor baseline, and tracking validity.
Runtime dispatches terminal evidence to the reducer and reducer suppresses duplicate/stale callbacks.
Internal SFX is driven by alternation acceptedRepEvent, while generic repCredited remains false.
Runtime finish emits an adapted SetResult with step-up metadata.
Progression consumes adapted SetResult as one reps set.
Step-up is rep-based and has no valid-time payload to double.
Active runtime envelope is schema-versioned and JSON-safe.
Restore validates fingerprint and retires partial attempts.
Compact backend state retains generated plan, active runtime, and seed.
Main-plan step-up completion flips the shared seed once.
Seed helper remains gated to main-plan completion; manual/explore scenarios use false main-plan credit.
Live context carries pinned plan and expected lead for logical V2.1 planning.
